connector.name: Agent Cold Email
connector.registryDescription: Agent-run cold-email infra: 24 MCP tools, live sending, free sandbox. $99/mo, concierge go-live.
connector.summary: Hosted at agent-cold-email-api.yaakovscher.workers.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package agent-cold-email. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ys-projectcalc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from POST /signup (free, no card) — or run `npx agent-cold-email demo` first

env.name: AGENT_COLD_EMAIL_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token from POST /signup (free, no card) — or run `npx agent-cold-email demo` first. Optional at startup: without it, `initialize`/`tools/list` still work (unauthenticated introspection), but every `tools/call` fails until a key is set.
